<div class="card-body">
'''Han Solo''' is the Japanese-language [[Premiere (Japanese)]] printing of [[Han Solo]].<ref name="encyclopedia">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41 and 98 (index 3983). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>


<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ハン・ソロ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">１回の戦闘に１度だけ、１フォース消費して、引いた運命数をキャンセルしてもう一度引きなおしてよい。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋２。宇宙船がミレニアム・ファルコンなら更に回避に＋２し、戦闘運命数を引けない場合に、１枚だけ引いてよい。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-han-solo-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">密輸屋兼ギャンブラー。反乱軍の英雄。コレリア人の熟練パイロットで。ミレニアム・ファルコンの所有者。副操縦士のチューバッカは、彼に“命の借り”がある。賞金首。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Han Solo.

'''Card text:''' Once per battle, you may use 1 Force to cancel a destiny just drawn and draw again. Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If it is the Millennium Falcon, also add 2 to maneuver and draw one battle destiny if none can otherwise be drawn.

'''Lore:''' A smuggler, gambler, and Rebel hero. A skilled Corellian pilot and owner of the Millennium Falcon. His co-pilot Chewbacca owes him a life debt. There is a bounty on his head.
